description: This file defines the internal readonly struct ObserverGrainId within the Orleans Runtime namespace. It includes methods for creating, parsing, comparing, and representing observer grain identifiers, which are used to identify client-side observer objects within Orleans cluster. The struct implements interfaces for equality, comparison, and span formatting.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ObserverGrainId instance using a ClientGrainId, generating a new GUID-based scoped ID.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ObserverGrainId instance with specified ClientGrainId and scoped IdSpan.

methods.name: IsObserverGrainId
methods.description: Checks whether a given GrainId represents an observer grain id (based on client status and presence of segment separator).

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Attempts to parse a GrainId into an ObserverGrainId if it conforms to the observer id format.
